content:
emma: opened PR to add a concise private/VPC on-prem checklist: network diagram, KMS/HSM quicknotes, systemd drop-in example, cert-bundle step, and tiny SDK snippets (Go + Python). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1533

harpreet: nice. please include both PKCS#11 socket paths and an ACL example. many customers run the HSM as root so kms user needs access.

lucas: added a minimal network sketch (SVG under assets/diagrams/onprem-kms.svg) and linked it with relative path. I kept alt text short: "onprem KMS/HSM topology".

nate: Systemd advice: prefer a drop-in override instead of shipping a full unit. Example to document:
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/kms-proxy.service.d/10-local.conf
[Service]
Environment=KMS_CONFIG=/etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml
Restart=on-failure
LimitNOFILE=65536
User=kms
```
Add note: run `systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now kms-proxy` and check `journalctl -u kms-proxy -f` for startup logs.

emma: good. harpreet can you paste the ACL + PKCS#11 path examples? also we should show a cert-bundle one-liner.

harpreet: sure: PKCS#11 paths: `/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock` (default) and `/var/lib/hsm/pkcs11.sock` (fallback). ACL example: `sudo setfacl -m u:kms:rw /var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock`. Cert bundle one-liner:
```bash
cat root.crt intermediate.crt client.crt > /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem && chown kms:kms /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem && chmod 640 /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem
```
Add note: client private keys may remain in the HSM; only certs are stored on disk.

lucas: SDK snippets: Python should use pathlib to avoid double-slash pain, Go should not use InsecureSkipVerify. Proposed snippets to include in the PR:
```py
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock')
client = KMSClient(endpoint=f'unix://{path.as_posix()}')
```
```go
creds := credentials.NewTLS(&tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: false})
conn, err := grpc.Dial(os.Getenv("KMS_ENDPOINT"), grpc.WithTransportCredentials(creds))
```
Also show env examples: `export KMS_ENDPOINT=unix:///var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock` or `export KMS_ENDPOINT=tls://kms.example:443`.

nate: tiny accessibility nit: ensure SVG alt text includes HSM so screen readers get context. lucas can you adjust?

lucas: done, changed to "On-prem KMS and HSM topology (kms-proxy, HSM, customer network)" and kept the file under assets/diagrams.

docs-bot: lint results: link-check OK, spelling: 1 warning ("priviledged" -> "privileged"), broken-anchor: 0. Preview: https://deploy-preview-1533--docs.redwood.ai/private-vpc-checklist

emma: thanks all 680 I'll merge in ~10m unless anyone objects. nate/hp can follow up with SELinux notes in a follow-up commit if needed.

harpreet: will add a brief SELinux tip after merge.

lucas: lgtm.

emma: merging now. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
